title: SkinBench: six AI models saw skin problems that were not there
summary: SkinBench, an AI skin analysis benchmark, shows where general-purpose models misread skin, and what beauty brands should test before trusting any vendor's results.

extraction.key_fact: AI 피부 분석 벤치마크가 범용 모델의 피부 오판 사례와 브랜드가 점검할 사항을 보여 준다
